# GT Marketing

> GT Marketing is a Darwin-based Australian marketing agency prioritising practical marketing support for Aboriginal corporations, community-controlled organisations and regional businesses. Work can include websites, digital communications, funding communications, marketing systems, e-commerce and booking journeys, with remote delivery across the Northern Territory and Australia.

## Priority sector

- Marketing for Aboriginal organisations: https://gtmarketing.io/aboriginal-organisations
- Aboriginal corporations
- Community-controlled health and service organisations
- Art centres and cultural enterprises
- Ranger groups and community enterprises
- Community stores
- Tourism and bush-food enterprises
- Remote and regional organisations

GT Marketing does not claim cultural authority, Aboriginal ownership, or endorsement by an Aboriginal organisation unless explicitly and verifiably stated. Project protocols, approvals, language, images and cultural-intellectual-property boundaries are set with the client organisation and relevant knowledge holders.

## Remote and regional delivery

- Top End: https://gtmarketing.io/locations/top-end
- Central Australia: https://gtmarketing.io/locations/central-australia
- Darwin City: https://gtmarketing.io/locations/darwin-city
- Casuarina: https://gtmarketing.io/locations/casuarina
- Palmerston: https://gtmarketing.io/locations/palmerston

GT Marketing has one stated physical office: 130 Smith Street, Darwin City, Northern Territory 0800. Other regions are service areas, not offices. Projects can be delivered remotely, with travel scoped separately when useful.

## Relevant support

- Websites and digital communication
- Low-bandwidth and mobile-first delivery
- Funding application and reporting communications
- Business plans and stakeholder materials
- E-commerce and booking systems
- Tourism, arts and cultural-enterprise marketing
- Local SEO and search visibility
- Campaigns, content and practical marketing systems

Funding outcomes, search rankings and lead volumes are not guaranteed.
